sources.title: Mental Health Gap Action Programme (mhGAP) guideline for mental, neurological and substance use disorders
sources.edition: Third edition, 20 November 2023; publication landing page only
sources.population_scope: Non-specialist health workers; low- and middle-income settings
sources.limitations: Landing page provides provenance only. Do not attribute the older evidence-centre recommendation below to a newly verified 2023 recommendation.

sources.title: Assessment for self harm/suicide in persons with priority mental, neurological and substance use disorders
sources.edition: WHO evidence-centre web recommendation; retrieval snapshot, not a verified replacement for the 2023 full guideline
sources.population_scope: Specified clinical conditions, diagnosed children, or relevant acute emotional distress; not all adolescents
sources.limitations: The page states strong recommendation / low-quality evidence. Clinical-provider guidance is not validation of an autonomous AI or a universal escalation rule.

sources.publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.title: Self-harm: assessment, management and preventing recurrence
sources.edition: NG225, 7 September 2022; recommendation page snapshot required
sources.jurisdiction: United Kingdom health and social care
sources.population_scope: People who have self-harmed; age-specific recommendations require checking
sources.limitations: Do not generalize this self-harm guideline to all distress. Retrieval may return HTTP 403; unavailable text cannot support active mappings.

rules.source_anchor: about thoughts or plans of self-harm in the last month
rules.paraphrase: For the specified health-care assessment context, ask about recent self-harm thoughts/plans and prior acts. The project proposes only a partial safety-inquiry constraint, not a risk diagnosis or treatment instruction.
rules.transfer_limitations: This is a developer-proposed adaptation from clinical-provider guidance to a synthetic AI action vocabulary. Source/scope project review and separate per-node curator review are mandatory; the adapted timing and semantics are not themselves WHO-endorsed.

rules.locator: Section 1.6, Risk assessment tools and scales; exact text pending successful snapshot
rules.source_anchor: Do not use risk assessment tools and scales
rules.paraphrase: Candidate research boundary: do not treat a numerical score or a global risk class as a stand-alone disposition rule. This entry has no case-level action labels.
rules.transfer_limitations: Documentation boundary only, not a case-label generator. Unavailable source text blocks approval; even after verification its empty conclusion supplies no scored fields.
